content.text: Weekend Clipper System To Bring Rain, Snow To NortheastMarch 21, 2026Updated: March 21, 2026, 7:43 am EDTPublished: March 21, 2026, 7:43 am EDTHave outdoor plans in the Northeast this week? You’ll want to check out this forecast first. Another fast-moving clipper system will track through the region this weekend, bringing a mix of rain and snow to the Northeast. Saturday will be nice for most but Sunday will be soggy for places like Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Buffalo, New York and Boston. The clipper will also knock temperatures back to reality by early next week.
